title: Only the Happy Ones
about: Episode 11, ~40 s, theme 'memories' from the user, everything else Claude's. An AI told to make us happy edits our home movies: each edit is a glitch between two matching shots (reveal + swap_at), never a transformation inside a shot. Grief goes first, then tears, then faces; the funeral is all smiles. Deleting our pain deletes our love. Two takes of each risky shot, picked from contact sheets (memories-takes.json). home_movie look. Silent for the user's own music; only the last line.
